name: Uncloven Satyr Hoof
summary: In Ashenvale, satyrs gorge themselves on the ancient forest’s magic. Their swollen hooves hold the power they steal, and Ula'elek uses it to forge armor in Sen'jin Village.

sections.title: Leeched Power
sections.body: Satyrs haunt the corrupted groves of northeastern Ashenvale, feeding on the ancient forest’s magical purity. The more they consume, the more corruption distorts their demonic bodies. Their hooves swell and lose their natural cleft, becoming dense stores of absorbed energy. Skilled shamans and leatherworkers can harvest that volatile power.

sections.title: Crafting the Brutal Armor
sections.body: At Sen'jin Village on Durotar’s coast, the troll armorer Ula'elek turns demonic corruption into strength for Horde champions. He takes hooves from satyrs that have fed on the forest and draws out their trapped magic. Then he channels that stolen power into brutal gauntlets, armor for young warriors facing the rigors of Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why are these satyr hooves uncloven?
faq.answer: Satyrs in Ashenvale feed on the forest’s sacred magic and corrupt it as they leech its power. Those that gorge themselves most develop swollen hooves that lose their cleft and hold the dense, stolen energy inside.

faq.q: Where can Uncloven Satyr Hooves be found?
faq.answer: Satyrs in the corrupted ruins and tainted groves of northeastern Ashenvale carry these hooves, including those near Satyrnaar and Night Run.

faq.q: Who wants these hooves in Durotar?
faq.answer: Ula'elek, an armorer in Sen'jin Village on Durotar’s southern coast, asks for seven hooves so he can draw out their stored magic.

faq.q: What are the hooves used to craft?
faq.answer: Ula'elek draws corrupt forest power from the hooves to forge a pair of sturdy, magic-infused brutal gauntlets.

angles.text: As a young warrior seeking renown, you can prove your martial prowess by hunting Ashenvale’s satyrs and commissioning specialized armor from Horde trainers in Sen'jin Village.
As a troll, you share the Darkspear crafters’ skill at turning dark or hostile energies into useful gear. Ula'elek leeches power from demonic foes instead of letting it go to waste.
